d: We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Development Director to lead residential and mixed-use real estate projects across Oman, from conceptualisation of projects to government approvals through construction completion and handover. This role owns project execution — coordinating internal teams, consultants, design managers, and government authorities such as the Ministry of Tourism, Ministry of Housing and local municipalities — while managing budgets, design processes, and approvals to deliver projects on time and on budget.
q: Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Engineering, Architecture, Construction Cost Management, or a related field (Master's a plus).
8-10 years of experience in real estate development, or related role, ideally with some experience in Oman or the wider GCC.
Working knowledge of land planning, and building-approval processes, construction methods, and real estate finance.
Ability to manage internal teams and professional consulting teams.
An excellent knowledge of development fundamentals and their application to the residential asset class.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with project management and financial modelling software.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills would be useful.
Ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings.
Valid driving license and willingness to travel to project sites across the Sultanate (Muscat and Salalah).
r: Manage development projects from pre-concept and financial modelling through design, government approvals, construction, and handover in conjunction with project management and design management teams.
Develop residential concepts with focus on market appetite, company strategy and development fundamentals.
Develop and maintain project feasibilities, manage variances and report to senior leadership.
Coordinate architects, engineers, and other consultants to ensure design and construction meet project goals and Omani building codes.

Lead the land planning and building permit approval processes, liaising with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, Muscat Municipality (or relevant Wilayat/Governorate authority), and other government bodies.
Manage relationships with key stakeholders, contractors, internal sales team, design team, project managers and senior leaders.
Review and negotiate contracts, change orders, and vendor agreements in coordination with legal and finance teams.
Identify and mitigate project risks, escalating issues and proposing solutions proactively.
Prepare regular status reports and presentations for executive leadership reviews.

d: The Inpatient Registered Nurse (RN) provides high-quality, patient-centered nursing care to individuals admitted to the inpatient unit. The role ensures safe clinical practice, accurate documentation, multidisciplinary coordination, and compliance with hospital policies, regulatory standards, and patient safety guidelines.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing (BSN) or equivalent.
Valid Nursing License/Registration from the national regulatory authority (NHRA or equivalent).
BLS certification (mandatory); ACLS/PALS preferred depending on unit.
Minimum 3–5 years of inpatient/acute-care nursing experience.
r: Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate individualized patient care plans.
Perform comprehensive nursing assessments and identify patient needs.
Provide direct nursing care including medication administration, wound care, vital signs monitoring, IV therapy, and patient hygiene.
Ensure timely response to patient needs, alarms, and changes in condition.
Maintain infection control standards and follow IPC guidelines.
Monitor patient progress and document all nursing interventions in EMR/clinical records.
Report any significant changes in patient condition to the physician or nurse manager promptly.
Ensure accurate handover communication during shift changes.
Collaborate with physicians, therapists, dietitians, and other healthcare professionals to optimize patient outcomes.
Participate in multidisciplinary rounds and care conferences.
Support discharge planning and ensure continuity of care.
Educate patients and families about care plans, medications, procedures, and health maintenance.
Provide emotional support and promote a positive patient experience.
Adhere to hospital clinical policies, nursing protocols, and regulatory standards (e.g., JCI, NHRA).
Promote a safe environment by identifying and reporting hazards, incidents, or near misses.
Participate in quality improvement initiatives, audits, and mandatory training sessions.
Maintain strict confidentiality of all patient information.
Demonstrate professional conduct aligned with the hospital’s values and code of ethics.
Support colleagues and contribute to a positive team culture.
Perform duties assigned by the Nurse Manager in emergency or special situations.
